newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel to head for 129.75 and above.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel to head for 129.75 and above.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF showed little vigour on Monday but a constructive chart pattern gives targets of 129.75 and beyond, technical analysts said.
"Notionnel is performing a tiny corrective pass above 129.30," Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrier Lullin in Geneva, said.

"It needs to persist above to set up a small uptick to 129.75 and then we should see an a-b-c retracement phase back to 129.00," he said, noting the market has been in a small upwards channel since April 28.
June notionnel futures were down 0.02 at 129.46 at 0952 GMT.
Bado said 129.75 was an Elliott Wave objective. Elliott Wave theory holds that markets follow repetitive patterns of five waves one way followed by three waves of correction.

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, expected the market to get a little further than 129.75, after it pushed through the upper limits of the resistance range last week. This aborted the potential of a head and shoulders top forming on weekly charts.
"This opens the way for a continuation of the strength over the next few days towards the next main resistance point at 130.32," he said in a research note.
That was the high on March 11, before the market slid.
He said corrections would be well supported at 129.16. Daily charts show a high here on April 30.
At the short-end, June Pibor futures were quoted at 96.38, down four basis points from Friday's settlement.
Bado expected further losses towards 96.25 but support around there to hold.
"It went there twice already and each time we rebounded on it," he said. Daily price charts show the market hitting a low of 96.27 on April 21 and a low of 96.26 on April 25.
Resistance remained strong around 96.46, Bado said. That was just above the top of the recent range high of 96.45 hit on May 2.
